text:
ROUGHRIDERS GALLOP TO WEEK 2 PFPI LEAD
AFTER ‘RIDERS, MANIACS SHARE WEEKLY TITLE

PFPI founding member and legend Dick’s Roughriders gallop to the Week 2 overall lead by 1 game over Christie’s Ferraris after the ‘Riders and Mom’s Maniacs share weekly honors with 11-5 records.

Gracelin’s Giraffes bag the week’s lone Unique Hit with a Coonskin for Raiders over Chargers.

And we’re off on PFPI’s 23rd season of the modern era – two weeks down and 16 to go – in the marathon climb to the Dad’s Dynamics Championship Trophy.
